svg.title: Advisory Intelligence Dispatch, Fallback Cascade, and NO-GO Boundary
svg.text: Fail-Closed Advisory Intelligence Pipeline & Fallback Architecture
Pre-RPC hard-constraint enforcement, bounded HTTP contracts, deterministic fallback, and live PostgreSQL visibility recheck
Condition x age decay x penalty
Rejects NaN/Inf scores, duplicate IDs, forged items
Checks entityVersion parity against local snapshot
Re-reads every ranked product ID from PostgreSQL
Filters out items deleted, hidden, blocked, or sold
during RPC flight before building response DTOs
Advisory snapshot can never leak private records
• Trust/Risk: score or clues + audited admin reason
• Zero automatic sanctions, suspensions, or edits
• Synthetic L0/demo rows excluded from accuracy claims
Learned-Model Accuracy Claims Remain Explicitly Gated (predictionMetrics = NOT_EVALUATED)
Requires: (1) >= 200 licensed L3 completed transactions (>= 30/stratum) (2) Non-author relevance set (3) Out-of-sample MAE/MAPE/coverage audit (4) Governance sign-off
